title: Power and Control Awareness (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to recognise controlling behaviours that harm partners and children, and to develop respectful, non-dominating relationship practices.
learningOutcomes: Understand how control affects children’s emotional safety.
Recognise subtle dominance patterns in parenting.

modules.title: Power in Fathering
modules.content: Explores how control affects children’s development and safety.

modules.title: Forms of Control
modules.content: Identifies emotional, financial, and coercive control.

modules.title: Respectful Equality
modules.content: Provides tools for shared decision-making and safe behaviour.
